page_title: MNU 4-0 EVE | Manchester Utd v Everton 01/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+3' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) is able to continue to play.
86' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

86' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes well past the left post.
84' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads low to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
82' Here is a change. James Tarkowski is going off and Sean Dyche gives the last tactical orders to Jake O'Brien (Everton).
80' That will be all from Kobbie Mainoo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mason Mount (Manchester United).
79' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
76' Manchester Utd seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
74' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) picks up a long through ball, but Andre Onana deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nathan Patterson (Everton) comes onto the pitch for Ashley Young.
71' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
70' The ball possession is 60:40.
67' Ashley Young (Everton) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
67' Substitution. Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) has come on for Beto.
66' Ruben Amorim has decided to substitute Casemiro and he is replaced by Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United).
66' Bruno Fernandes comes off the pitch to be replaced by Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United).
66' That's the end of the game for Jesper Lindstrom, who is replaced by Jack Harrison (Everton).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Orel Mangala (Everton) replaces Idrissa Gueye.

64' 4 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Amad Diallo, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United), who beats Jordan Pickford with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 4:0.
63' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
62' Everton have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
60' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Everton.
57' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
56' Ruben Amorim prepares a substitution. Noussair Mazraoui is replaced by Luke Shaw (Manchester United).
56' The substitution has been made. Harry Maguire (Manchester United) has replaced Matthijs de Ligt.
54' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
54' The corner is swung in but Everton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
51' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
51' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
50' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) on the edge of the box.
50' Everton are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
49' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) will miss the next game.
49' What was Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

46' 3 - 0 Goal Marcus Rashford (Manchester United)! Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) was put through by Amad Diallo and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 3:0.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' John Brooks has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
41' 2 - 0 Goal Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United)! Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) was put through by Bruno Fernandes and he showed brilliant composure to tuck it home from inside the box. 2:0.
40' It seemed like Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
39' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
37' The shots on goal statistics – 2:1.

34' 1 - 0 The ball hits the back of the net! Bruno Fernandes delivers the corner, Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) finds himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes an unstoppable shot which goes into the bottom left corner and past the helpless goalkeeper. 1:0.
34' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
30' John Brooks blows his whistle after Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
27' The Manchester Utd players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
24' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andre Onana intercepts the ball.
21' Beto (Everton) gets past Andre Onana in goal, but is driven too wide and the angle is just too tough to find the net.
20' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is caught in the offside trap after the defenders step up as one at the very right moment.
18' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) tries to find Marcus Rashford, but he puts too much power on the pass.
16' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Jesper Lindstrom (Everton), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
14' Joshua Zirkzee plays a pass to Amad Diallo (Manchester United), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball flies well wide of the left post.
12' The ball falls kindly for Beto (Everton) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the left post.

10' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Andre Onana!
8' The ball breaks to Amad Diallo (Manchester United) after a scramble in the box, but his first-time effort is immediately blocked.
8' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
6' Beto (Everton) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
5' The ball is cleared after Dwight McNeil (Everton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
4' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Jordan Pickford has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
3' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Manchester Utd will take the kick-off.
John Brooks will supervise the game today.
